info.title: Penny native integration API
info.description: Existing scoped REST operations only. Lists are returned as arrays; pagination and additional operator resource families are not implemented. Request lists accept only the documented filters. Other list operations ignore extra query values. Issue keys through authenticated native integration settings. Keys do not admit operator pages, exports or configuration. Publication needs explicit approval and existing native prerequisites.

integrationKey.description: Reveal-once key issued by this installation. Each operation names its required native scope in x-required-scopes. Insufficient scope returns 401.

CreateRequest.description: Evidence identifiers must be distinct and exist. Creates held wording awaiting native moderation; this operation does not publish it.

PublishStatus.description: Explicit approval and an idempotency key are required. Repeating the same action reuses its result; changed wording under that key is refused. ETA is a month or quarter.

CreateRelease.description: A valid calendar publication date is required. Setup URL is empty or HTTP or HTTPS. Tags must exist; targets must have current approved request mappings. Creates a draft attributed to the key issuer.

RecordProxyVote.description: Select exactly one active requesterId or new contact. A source URL uses HTTP or HTTPS without embedded credentials. Importance requires the board setting. No identity verification or email permission is granted.
